summary: Form refinement improves the connected organic body and dense surface systems, but the atria/fat/coronary feature group remains below its pass threshold and requires a bounded code correction.

featureReviews.notes: Closed C1 loft and right-biased apex retain the reference silhouette.
Connected aortic and pulmonary systems retain the intended macro topology.
Fails form threshold: fat bed buries central lobules, major trunks sit too proud, and auricular ripples are harsh and regular.

notes: Refine code with these bounded changes: flatten fat-bed normal depth to 0.45 of current while retaining width; lower main red coronary center 0.093 to 0.060 and blue 0.087 to 0.058; reduce auricle ripple 0.072 to 0.045; move buried pulmonary start y 590 to 564; add a superior fat collar path matching the upper groove. The blue pulmonary root currently extends too far inferior. This is not a continue decision and does not claim final or clinical fidelity.
